The '''Tao-Grant system''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tao-Grant]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Second moon of Tao-Grant|Tao-Grant 2]]
